combat.attack_speed_reference: Valve gameplay update 7.20: total maximum attack speed 700; standalone adopts this documented default, not an in-match GemTD measurement.
combat.projectiles: tracking; source ProjectileSpeed / 128 cells per second; damage and on-hit at impact

economy.odds_purchase: Base gold prices equal source XP threshold differences. Each defeated base boss grants 150 gold and 150 banked odds-only discount. Unused discount carries forward; purchases remain manual.

balance_note: Solo campaign: source snapshot 2026-08-01, 50 base waves plus 50 trials. Gold odds purchases are an adaptation. Gem prays and castle heal are source hero spells at level 1, bought with gold during building; other hero abilities, weekly themes and random elites are excluded. Tracking attacks use source projectile speeds and a documented Dota total attack-speed cap of 700. Explicit source PRD events use calibrated standalone smoothing; exact Valve RNG and engine event ordering are not match-verified.
